SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S.I, Special Branch .../d/h&K...
REPORT
Date August 10, 19 38.
Subject N.A. Mohneff, applicant for a certificate of character.
Made by. D.P.S. Pavloff Forwarded by. C G...

Nicolai Alexandrovitch MOHNEFF, Russian was born
in Kazan, Russia, on May 7, 1895.
According to his own statement he had escaped from
the U.S.S.R. into Manchuria in 1926 and subsequently resided
in Harbin. He arrived in Shanghai in 1929 and here had
been appearing as a professional wrestler. Later he was
employed as a bouncer by various cabarets. During the
period when thus employed he first came to the notice of
the Police when on December 3, 1931 he was charged with
Assault and fined $30.00 by the 1st Special District Court.
On July 17, 1935, he obtained his present employment as a
driver with Mollers, Ltd.
He is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and at present resides at
83 Wayside Road.
Since the time he was charged with Assault, the
applicant did not come to the notice of the Municipal Police
in connection with any other activities of an undesirable
nature.

日期：1938年8月10日。
事由：N.A. Mohneff，品行证明书申请人。
呈报人：D.P.S. Pavloff 转呈人：C G...

Nicolai Alexandrovitch MOHNEFF，俄国人，1895年5月7日出生于俄国喀山。
据其自述，他于1926年从苏联逃往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨。他于1929年抵达上海，在此以职业摔跤手身份亮相。后来，他被多家歌舞厅雇佣为保镖（bouncer）。在此期间，他首次引起警方注意，原因是1931年12月3日，他被第一特区地方法院指控犯有袭击罪，并被罚款30.00元。
1935年7月17日，他获得了目前在莫勒有限公司（Mollers, Ltd.）担任司机的职位。
他在茂名南路118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记，目前居住在威赛路83号。
自被指控袭击以来，该申请人未因其他任何不良行为引起公共租界警方的注意。

The Chief
of the English
Municipal Police.
Shanghai.

Nikolai Alexandrovitch Monneff.
83 Wayside Road, Shanghai.

Shanghai, 3-rd of August, 1935.

Dear Sir,

Will you kindly provide me with a certificate testify-
ing to my having never been tried in court and to my never
having been in prison. Also to my having never been mixed up
with any political organizations or activities.

I am in urgent need of this certificate, as I must
attach it to the application for the Permit to enter Austra-
lia, which Application I am now sending to Canberra, Austra-
lia. Without this certificate the said Application will not
be valid, and, hence, will not be accepted for consideration
by the Government of Australia.

Hoping you will kindly oblige me, I beg to remain,

your most obedient servant

N. Monneff.

警务处处长。
上海。

Nikolai Alexandrovitch Monneff.
上海威赛路83号。

上海，1935年8月3日。

尊敬的先生：

恳请阁下出具一份证明，证实我从未受过法庭审判，也从未入狱。同时证明我从未卷入任何政治组织或活动。

我急需此证明，因为我必须将其附在入境澳大利亚的许可证申请上，该申请我正寄往澳大利亚堪培拉。若无此证明，上述申请将无效，因此也不会被澳大利亚政府受理考虑。

盼请惠予协助，谨此

您最顺从的仆人

N. Monneff.
